sample_unit: consecutive noncontrast CT scans (real-world opportunistic screening phase)
models_evaluated: GRAPE (Gastric Cancer Risk Assessment Procedure with Artificial Intelligence)

links.outcome: AUC on internal validation versus independent multicenter external cohort
links.effect: Internal validation AUC 0.970 (1,298 cases); external cohort from 16 centers AUC 0.927 (18,160 cases), a modest drop but still strong performance.
links.quote: First, we developed GRAPE using a cohort from 2 centers in China (3,470 GC and 3,250 non-GC cases) and validated its performance on an internal validation set (1,298 cases, area under curve = 0.970) and an independent external cohort from 16 centers (18,160 cases, area under curve = 0.927).

screen.reason: Evaluated deep learning for gastric cancer detection on noncontrast CT in reader studies (radiologist assistance) and real-world opportunistic screening across hospitals.
